title: Binding Free Energy of Protein/Ligand Complexes Calculated using Dissociation Parallel Cascade Selection Molecular Dynamics and Markov State Model
authors: Hiroaki Hata; Duy Tran; Mohamed Marzouk; Akio Kitao
one_liner_zh: 该文用dPaCS-MD/MSM方法计算蛋白-配体复合物的结合自由能，虽非TF-DNA体系，但分子解离模拟与自由能计算方法可迁移至蛋白质-DNA互作建模，具有方法学借鉴价值。
abstract: We recently proposed a computational procedure to simulate the dissociation of protein/ligand complexes using the dissociation Parallel Cascade Selection Molecular Dynamics simulation (dPaCS-MD) method and to analyze the generated trajectories using the Markov state model (MSM). This procedure, called dPaCS-MD/MSM, enables calculation of the dissociation free energy profile and the standard binding free energy. To examine whether this method can reproduce experimentally determined binding free energies for a variety of systems, we used it to investigate the dissociation of three protein/ligand complexes: trypsin/benzamine, FKBP/FK506, and adenosine A2A receptor/T4E. First, dPaCS-MD generated multiple dissociation pathways within a reasonable computational time for all the complexes, although the complexes differed significantly in the size of the molecules and in intermolecular interactions. Subsequent MSM analyses produced free energy profiles for the dissociations, which provided insights into how each ligand dissociates from the protein. The standard binding free energies obtained by dPaCS-MD/MSM are in good agreement with experimental values for all the complexes. We conclude that dPaCS-MD/MSM can accurately calculate the binding free energies of these complexes.
abstract_zh: 我们近期提出了一种计算流程，用于模拟蛋白质/配体复合物的解离，采用解离并行级联选择分子动力学模拟（dPaCS-MD）方法，并利用马尔可夫状态模型（MSM）分析生成的轨迹。该流程称为dPaCS-MD/MSM，能够计算解离自由能谱和标准结合自由能。为检验该方法能否重现多种系统实验测定的结合自由能，我们将其应用于研究三个蛋白质/配体复合物的解离：胰蛋白酶/苯甲胺、FKBP/FK506和腺苷A2A受体/T4E。首先，dPaCS-MD在合理的计算时间内为所有复合物生成了多条解离路径，尽管这些复合物在分子大小和分子间相互作用上存在显著差异。随后的MSM分析产生了解离的自由能谱，为每种配体如何从蛋白质解离提供了见解。通过dPaCS-MD/MSM获得的标准结合自由能与所有复合物的实验值高度一致。我们得出结论，dPaCS-MD/MSM能够准确计算这些复合物的结合自由能。
